meta.name: broken-link-checker
meta.description: Scans a website to find broken links (404s, 500s). Crawls internal pages,  identifies broken outbound links, and reports source pages for easy fixing. Use this when the user asks to "check for broken links", "find 404s",  "audit my links", or "is my site healthy".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描网站找出所有失效链接并报告来源页
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期检查网站链接健康度，避免用户遇到404错误。
copy.tagline_en: Scan a website to find all broken links and report source pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly check your website for broken links and avoid 404 errors.

howto.what: 若用户未提供网址,先询问要检查哪个网站;然后扫描该网站,找出返回 404(不存在)或 5xx(服务器错误)的链接,爬取内部页面,识别失效的外部链接,并列出坏链接的来源页面以便修复。
howto.when: 当用户要求“check for broken links”“find 404s”,或说“audit my links”等时触发。

say.text: 检查 https://example.com 有没有坏链接
say.note: 脚本会扫描并报告404和5xx错误。

say.text: 帮我找出 https://example.com 上所有失效的链接
say.note: 会标明每个坏链接所在的页面。

say.text: 审计 https://example.com 的链接,有404请告诉我
say.note: 会按内部/外部分组,便于优先修复。

howto.what_en: Scans a given website for broken links (404s, 5xx). Crawls internal pages, detects broken outbound links, and reports the source pages for fixing. Asks for a URL if none is given.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check for broken links, find 404s, audit my links, etc.

say_en.note: Scans the site and reports 404/5xx errors.

say_en.text: Find all broken links on https://example.com.
say_en.note: Lists each broken link's source pages.
